title: Audit source, relationships, evidence and supplier file receiving

task.name: Receive and operate a complete audit-source migration edition
task.purpose: Give the original audit owner, specialist supplier and receiving engineer a complete source-qualified route from original records and evidence through explicit mappings, relationship review and supplied target files to actual returned-data comparison.
task.request: Retain all complete original CSV and binary files, original headers/cells, compound namespace/role/key identities, twelve neutral migration roles, explicit many-to-many references and each attributed correction. Preserve every scope, review, supplier contract, prepared table and observed return. Inspect original/effective row witnesses, document byte bindings and declared permissions/history without treating them as enforced authorization or an audit opinion. Select every retained edition for the agreed work, with an inclusion or exclusion purpose. Use the same original engine, CLI and offline browser; prepare the existing Workshare/Customer Installation and independently reopen both the full source application and saved commercial case. Actual supplied target templates and return files remain original inputs; no vendor write endpoint or native schema is inferred.
task.completeOutput: Complete original working recovery, all retained text/binary sources, mappings and source-bound findings, explicit role coverage, full scope/review/preparation/return history, unchanged unfinished writing and browser copy, readable inventory, editable HTML/JSON/ZIP/source, the saved original Installation and independently reopened source and case.
task.repeatTrigger: An authorized original source replacement, mapping or correction, changed review/scope, supplied template, actual returned file or deliberately agreed further reconciliation creates useful later work. An unchanged retry or reopen keeps its original operation and history.
task.pricedUnit: The original agreement’s complete audit-source preparation, migration rehearsal, return reconciliation or handover task. Keep exact fees, effort, milestones, support and source allowances in the original commercial Workshare; actual merchant resource prices remain separately selected.

source.reference: Exact complete Audit working JSON or recovery envelope with original workspace genesis, revision and operations; each selected file/mapping/scope/review/contract/preparation/return; complete original commercial case.
source.population: Every original physical file and CSV row; all neutral-role mappings, corrections, source selections, reviews, supplied contracts, prepared files and actual return comparisons. Scope choices never remove original source, history or unfinished forms.
source.meaning: Retain ordered duplicate headers, quoted empty and absent cells, opaque case-sensitive compound keys, every row variant, original relationship witnesses and exact document bytes. Neutral roles are not supplier-native tables. Permissions/history are source assertions, not local enforcement. Historical public references, authored examples and actual operational records remain distinguishable; no audit opinion or native status is inferred.
source.changePolicy: New source, mapping, correction or scope is a new original operation. Prior prepared CSV and actual return comparisons remain frozen. A source edit may stale an earlier review but does not rewrite it. Preserve both conflicting browser branches and later receiving-side descendants. A changed commercial scope follows the original case.

receiving.application: Original offline Audit Source Workspace, original Node CLI and typed merchant Tools within the selected full source, beside the existing Grant Operations Applications and Customer Installation. No audit server or second source store.
receiving.acceptanceRule: Attach byte-complete original recovery and whole edition scope to the original Operations case; obtain the matching fresh commercial seed. Prepare, preview and save through the maintained Installation writer. Independently receive all source/application files and the exact saved Installation, verify every selected original before import and reopen both histories. Record actual rendered controls, all attachments and a later preserved source edit.
receiving.changeAndWithdraw: Original owners control source rights, supplier access, permissions, retention and disclosure. The specialist prime owns actual destination loading and confirmation. A local file preparation is not a vendor write; a supplier receipt does not prove returned-data completeness or permission enforcement. Retain historical source statements when later work is revised.
receiving.recovery: Keep original complete source, selection, case, seed, bindings, exact program source, saved Installation IDs and receiving directories. Reuse the same original request after response loss. Missing staging can resume from retained full bytes; different still-present originals are a conflict. Later recipient work and drafts remain in Current_Working_Recovery.json.
receiving.maintenance: Name the audit source owner, specialist platform owner, engineer and receiving operator. Retain complete source/dependencies, exact original CLI/browser controls and original case terms. Producing peers personally open, use and LOOK at the exact app and every attachment, usable ZIP content, PDF page, print view and reopened working file at desktop1440 and narrow390. Each warm message and exact attachments require Bryce’s per-message green.

steps.title: Receive complete agreed work
steps.result: Select the original full Workshare and matching case. Preserve all commercial phases, amounts, effort, support, ownership and open checks.

steps.title: Install whole maintained source
steps.result: Build the audit-migration selection with complete original engine, CLI, browser, source guides and Grant Operations.

steps.title: Retain complete original source
steps.result: Export full recovery with unfinished forms and copy identity; attach exact bytes to the original case and inspect every retained edition.

steps.title: Select customer scope explicitly
steps.result: Record each original edition’s exact kind/index/ID/hash and inclusion or exclusion purpose. Attach the full scope and refresh the case and commercial seed.

steps.title: Prepare and save Installation
steps.result: Use actual host, actor, source rights, deployment and payment selections. Preview and save through the existing native writer.

steps.title: Review original audit continuity
steps.result: Operate original mapping, source findings, relationships, document bindings and permission/history coverage. Preserve missing/ambiguous evidence and source assertions.

steps.title: Prepare supplied target and actual returns
steps.result: Use original supplier CSV templates and explicit field/key/reference/crosswalk bindings. Compare every supplied returned row to its frozen prepared edition; retain missing, changed, unexpected and unconfirmed data.

steps.title: Receive both complete workspaces
steps.result: Retain full prepared source and application, verify original case/Installation/source before import, then independently reopen source and case.

steps.title: Continue preserved later work
steps.result: Save a useful permitted receiving-side change and unfinished writing under the independent copy; repeat the original receiving and observe its surviving descendant.

steps.title: Inspect and hand over actual product
steps.result: Personally operate and view exact desktop/narrow product, readable full reports, original attachments, usable ZIP contents and all applicable PDF pages. Save actual results in the same original programme.

inputs: Full original commercial Workshare source/packet, actual customer case, selected plan and same-version native seed.
Complete original Audit workspace or recovery JSON, including all binary/text sources, twelve-role mappings, corrections, scopes, reviews, templates, prepared/returned rows and operation history.
Whole edition scope with exact original kind/index/ID/content identity and explicit purpose for each inclusion or exclusion.
Actual source-use authority, original data dictionary/relationships and documented permission/history/evidence coverage; unconfirmed semantics stay explicit.
When commissioned, complete supplier-provided templates, exact key/reference crosswalks, actual returned files and independently observed destination behavior.
Actual named host/operator/deployments and existing Node22.16+ and Grant Operations Python3.11+ runtime; original and independent receiving directories.

Operations attachment allowance remains8MiB each,24MiB total and200files. The offline complete working file limit is128MiB including unfinished writing; retain larger original source through an appropriate complete custody route.
Exact full rendered product and all-attachment observations, original logs/files, selected Installation and personal producer LOOK.
